اصطخبن (form VIII)
# اِصْطَخَبْنَ (iṣṭaḵabna) /isˤ.tˤa.xab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِصْطَخَبَ (iṣṭaḵaba)
# اُصْطُخِبْنَ (uṣṭuḵibna) /usˤ.tˤu.xib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِصْطَخَبَ (iṣṭaḵaba)
# اِصْطَخِبْنَ (iṣṭaḵibna) /isˤ.tˤa.xib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِصْطَخَبَ (iṣṭaḵaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
